Investments

The Washington Harbour Ecosystem of Investments

We believe that government, innovators and private capital must work together to advance American competitiveness. That’s why we invest in technology innovators who enhance impact and outcome across cybersecurity, government and enterprise. Our investments range from Series A through Pre-IPO, providing innovators with the capital, expertise and resources to deliver at scale, with speed.*

*(1) BMC2 refers to Battle Management Command and Control, the decision and management process within operational environments. (2) C-UAS refers to Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System, a term for solutions that detect, track, and disrupt unmanned airborne vehicles.

No investments match these filters.
